Victoria 3 Expands The Russian Flavor In New “State and Revolution” DLC

By Matt Donahue09/04/20264 Mins Read
Share
Facebook Twitter Pinterest Reddit WhatsApp Email
Listen to audio version of this article
Sponsored by
0:00 / 3:48
Instaread

Victoria 3 is looking to Russia for its next expansion with “State and Revolution.” Set to release on October 22, 2026, in Paradox Interactive’s grand strategy game and global societal sim from 1836 to 1936, the “State and Revolution” immersion pack for Victoria 3 brings deeper historical flavor and content for the Russian Empire.

About Victoria 3, we said, “Victoria 3 is a game that requires patience and homework, but once you get the hang of things, it can be tons of fun. The game offers so much variety, both in terms of ways to play and succeed, and in the unique challenges across the array of nations to choose from.”

What is Victoria 3: State and Revolution about?

The “State and Revolution” immersion pack is bringing Tsarist Russia even more depth in Victoria 3. In this new immersion pack, players’ Tsars‘ personalities and characters will affect their power at court, while their choices as a monarchy through policy will shape the terms of revolution as players approach the late game with the Russian Empire. You can prop up the monarchy and the state, or you can side with the revolution and the people. 

You can find the flavor description of the newest Victoria 3 DLC below:

For centuries, the Romanov tsars kept a firm hand on the reins of power in Russia. The court ran all policy and planning, with tsars and royal favorites directing the future of an empire with immense wealth and potential, only hesitantly unlocked by a conservative ruling class.

But the changes of the 19th century threaten to topple an increasingly brittle system, as new technologies, national awakenings and political ideologies point to a different and possibly better future for the millions under Russian rule. Which side will you choose?

The immersion pack will also add new, updated visual effects to indicate seasonal changes across the globe, new historical characters, new Cosmetic Content including a new building style, character assets, interface and map skin, and table assets, and finally new Music inspired by Russian imperial and revolutionary ambitions.

Watch the Trailer

 

Victoria 3: State and Revolution immersion pack will add:

  • Character-Driven Tsars: Like other characters in the game, “State and Revolution” will bring new dynamic Journal Entries based on the traits of the reigning Tsar in power, which will allow players to use different actions depending on the Tsar’s traits and other factors to achieve their ambitions.
  • Dynamic Revolutions: Potential Russian revolutions transpire based on the Tsarist Governments, and the legacy of your predecessors. While the game is a historical simulation, players’ choices will impact the severity and length of the revolutions they encounter. 
  • The Russian Civil War: The introduction of the Civil War will let players seize control of the future as the state threatens to collapse around them. As the game continues, players can build post-revolutionary Russia based on its outcome, with the choice to create a communist government or pursue their designs for a different post-revolutionary regime.
  • The National Struggles:
    • A new Journal Entry dealing with the pursuit of Russification in the Empire.
    • Experience Ukrainian and Belarusian cultural renaissances.
    • Narrative content for Poland and other nations vying for independence from Russia.
  • Tsarist Autocracy:
    • Exile unwanted dissidents to Siberia to ensure power stays with you – though the outcome may not always be what you expect.
    • As an autocratic ruler, appoint favorites, adopt their ideological stances, and engage in narrative content around their newfound powers.

What is the Victoria 3 DLC release date?

Victoria 3: State and Revolution will be available on October 22, 2026, for the suggested retail price of $14.99 USD on PC. Additionally, players with the Victoria 3 Volume 3 Expansion Pass will receive this immersion pack.
